005package com.stuypulse.robot.opmodes;
006
007import com.stuypulse.robot.Robot;
008import com.stuypulse.robot.commands.auton.Auton;
009
010import org.wpilib.opmode.OpMode;
011
012import java.util.function.Consumer;
013import org.littletonrobotics.junction.networktables.LoggedNetworkChooser;
014
015public class AutonOpMode implements OpMode {
016    protected static final LoggedNetworkChooser<Auton> chooser =
017            new LoggedNetworkChooser<>("Auton");
018
019    protected final Robot robot;
020    protected Auton auto;
021
022    public static void addDefaultAuton(String name, Auton auton) {
023        chooser.addDefault(name, auton);
024    }
025
026    public static void addAuton(String name, Auton auton) {
027        chooser.add(name, auton);
028    }
029
030    public AutonOpMode(Robot robot) {
031        this.robot = robot;
032
033        setAuto(chooser.getSelected());
034        chooser.onChange(this::setAuto);
035    }
036
037    private void setAuto(Auton auton) {
038        ifNotNull(Auton::clearPaths);
039        auto = auton;
040        ifNotNull(Auton::displayPaths);
041    }
042
043    private void ifNotNull(Consumer<Auton> consumer) {
044        if (auto != null) {
045            consumer.accept(auto);
046        }
047    }
048
049    @Override
050    public final void start() {
051        ifNotNull(Auton::clearPaths);
052
053        auto = chooser.getSelected();
054
055        ifNotNull(a -> robot.defaultScheduler.schedule(a.getCommand()));
056        this.startCallback();
057    }
058
059    /**
060     * Start callback method for being overridden by extending autons
061     *
062     * <p>Will run after the command is scheduled and auto paths cleared from the display
063     */
064    protected void startCallback() {}
065
066    @Override
067    public final void end() {
068        ifNotNull(a -> robot.defaultScheduler.cancel(a.getCommand()));
069        this.endCallback();
070    }
071
072    @Override
073    public final void close() {
074        ifNotNull(a -> robot.defaultScheduler.cancel(a.getCommand()));
075        ifNotNull(Auton::clearPaths);
076        chooser.onChange(null);
077        this.closeCallback();
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * End callback method for being overridden by extending autons
082     *
083     * <p>Will run after the command is canceled and auto paths cleared from the display
084     */
085    public void endCallback() {}
086
087    /**
088     * Close callback method for being overridden by extending autons
089     *
090     * <p>Will run after the command is canceled, auto paths cleared from the display, and the
091     * chooser listener is removed
092     */
093    public void closeCallback() {}
094}
